items.a: HBCField is a field service management platform that unifies task dispatch, real-time GPS tracking, employee time & attendance, and service reports in one system — connecting the office and the field.

Companies that dispatch technicians or field workers — maintenance, HVAC, plumbing, electrical, cleaning, security, landscaping and property management — that want jobs, people and time tracking in one place.

items.q: What platforms does HBCField run on?
items.a: A web app for admins and dispatchers, and native iOS and Android apps for field technicians.

items.q: How does GPS route tracking work?
items.a: A native background service records the technician’s route with distance-based sampling — a point roughly every 25 metres — even when the phone is locked, and keeps the route history on record.
Technicians clock in on site against their assigned location, so attendance hours are verified by location rather than self-reported.

privacy.intro: HBC Group GmbH ("we", "our", "us") operates the HBCField mobile application and web platform. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your information when you use our services.

s1.title: 1. Information We Collect
s1.accountRole: Role and permissions within your organization

s1.gps2: When clocking in or out (single GPS fix for attendance verification)
s1.gps3: When marking arrival at a job site (geofence verification)
s1.cachedText: — used for presence indicators on the dispatcher's live map. This uses the device's last known position without activating the GPS radio.

s5.euPre: All data is stored on servers located in the
s5.item2: Data is encrypted in transit using TLS/HTTPS
s5.item3: Passwords are hashed using bcrypt with cost factor 12
s5.item4: Authentication tokens are SHA-256 hashed before storage

myTimeoff.title: Your time off

joinRequests.title: Join requests

manage.title: Management hub

availability.title: Availability

employeeDetail.title: Technician profile

memberDetail.title: Member profile

customers.title: Customers

field.title: Out in the field

offSite.title: Off-site

offDuty.title: Off duty

spaceActions.title: Space actions

activity.title: Recent activity

pending.title: Pending actions

tasks.title: Jobs

team.title: Your team

contacts.title: Reach your team

yourSpaces.title: Your spaces

openSpace.title: Inside your space

tasks.title: Jobs

intro.title: Find a job
intro.body: Search by title or details to quickly find the job you need.

views.title: Switch views
views.body: Flip between list, board and schedule to see your jobs the way that suits you.

list.title: Your job list
list.body: Every job assigned to you, at a glance — click any row to open it and start working.

intro.title: Your attendance
intro.body: Clock in and out, take breaks, and see your hours for the day.

clock.title: Start your shift
clock.body: Tap Clock In when you start and Clock Out when you finish. It uses your device location to confirm you're on site.

status.title: Where you stand
status.body: See whether you're clocked in and how long you've been on the clock right now.

history.title: Your recent hours
history.body: Your latest clock-ins and clock-outs, with the time worked for each.

search.title: Find anything
search.body: Search jobs by title or details as your list grows.

board.title: Board view
board.body: Jobs sit in columns by status. Drag a card to another column to change its status.

list.title: List view
list.body: A compact table to scan, sort and group your jobs — click any row to open it.

schedule.title: Schedule view
schedule.body: Your jobs on a timeline and calendar, by due date — great for planning the week.

views.title: Switch views anytime
views.body: Use these buttons to jump between the list, board and schedule whenever you like.

create.title: Create a job
create.body: Let's make one — click New Task to open the form.

title.title: Name the job
title.body: Give it a clear title, like the address and the problem.

save.title: Save it
save.body: Add a technician and details, then Save to create the job.

search.title: Find people
search.body: Search your members by name or email.

invite.title: Invite a teammate
invite.body: Click Invite to send someone a join link with the right role.

send.title: Send the invite
send.body: Set the email and role, then send — they'll get a join link.

intro.title: Your spaces
intro.body: Spaces group your jobs, people and reports — like a site, a department or a project. Everything on a space is scoped to it.

card.title: A space at a glance
card.body: Each card shows the space's name, whether it's active, how many members it has, its address, and the features (modules) it has turned on.

configure.title: Configure
configure.body: Open the full settings for a space — general details & map, the modules it uses, its job workflow, and the people assigned to it.

viewTasks.title: View its jobs
viewTasks.body: Jump straight to every job that belongs to this space.

actions.title: More actions
actions.body: Deactivate a space (it's never hard-deleted) or reactivate it later from here.

create.title: Add a space
create.body: Click New Space to create one — let's walk through the form.

name.title: Name it
name.body: Give the space a clear name — a site, team or project.

type.title: Workspace or physical
type.body: A Workspace is a logical group (a team or project). A Physical space is a real location with an address and geofence — pick that for on-site attendance.

physical.title: Location & geofence
physical.body: For a physical space: set the address, drop the pin on the map, and size the geofence radius — the zone members must be inside to clock in on site.

workflow.title: Job workflow
workflow.body: Choose the status flow jobs in this space follow (New → In Progress → Done…) — or build a custom one right here.

modules.title: Features (modules)
modules.body: Expand to turn features on or off for this space — subtasks, checklists, attachments, tracking and more, or apply a preset bundle.

submit.title: Create it
submit.body: Create the space — you can change everything later from Configure.

intro.title: Attendance
intro.body: Everything about hours worked lives here — who's clocked in, the records, approvals and breaks.

addDayOff.title: Add a day off
addDayOff.body: Mark someone off for a day or a date range (vacation, sick, holiday…) so the schedule and payroll stay right.

addAttendance.title: Add attendance
addAttendance.body: Manually log or back-date a shift for someone. One day, or backfill a whole date range filtered to certain weekdays.

tabs.title: Three views
tabs.body: Tracking (the records), Approvals (entries that need a yes/no) and Breaks. The badges show how many need your attention.

trackingStats.title: Today's totals
trackingStats.body: A quick read on right now — who's active, completed shifts, auto clock-outs and total hours.

trackingFilters.title: Find records
trackingFilters.body: Search by name and filter by location, status or date range — or use a quick preset like Today or This Week.

trackingTable.title: The records
trackingTable.body: Every shift: worker, status, clock in/out, hours, approval state and flags (overtime, missed clock-out, outside geofence…). Admins can edit any entry with the pencil.

approvalsTab.title: Approvals
approvalsTab.body: Flagged entries wait here for a decision — the badge counts how many are pending.

approvals.title: Approve or reject
approvals.body: Review each flagged shift — worker, times, hours and why it was flagged — then approve it, or reject with a reason.

breaksTab.title: Breaks
breaksTab.body: Track break time across the team — the badge shows who's on a break right now.

breaks.title: Breaks overview
breaks.body: Break totals by type, who's currently on break (admins can end one), and the full break history with filters.

intro.title: Reports
intro.body: Answer any question about your team, jobs, tasks and customers — build a report, run it, and export or schedule it.

saved.title: Your templates
saved.body: Reports you've saved live here — click one to reload it instantly. Build once, reuse forever.

builder.title: Report builder
builder.body: Start a fresh report here. Let's open it and walk through building one.

dataset.title: Pick a dataset
dataset.body: Choose what you're reporting on — attendance, jobs, tasks, customers… Each dataset offers its own measures and groupings.

measures.title: Measures
measures.body: The numbers to calculate — hours, counts, totals. Pick one or more; these become your columns and KPIs.

dimensions.title: Group by
dimensions.body: Break the numbers down — by person, space, customer, status… Leave empty for a single grand total.

period.title: Period
period.body: Choose the date range (a preset or a custom span), and optionally split it by day, week or month.

run.title: Run it
run.body: Run the report — the results appear just below as KPI cards, a chart and a full table.

results.title: Results
results.body: Your answer at a glance: KPI totals up top, a ranked chart, and the full data table beneath.

save.title: Save as template
save.body: Save this setup as a reusable template (optionally shared with the team) so you never rebuild it.

export.title: Export
export.body: Download as CSV, or open the PDF studio to produce a polished, branded document with your logo — and on higher plans, schedule it to email automatically.

header.title: The job
header.body: The title, live status and workflow buttons are up top — rename the job, move it to the next stage, reassign it, or use the ⋯ menu to edit or cancel.

progress.title: Progress & assignee
progress.body: See the job move through each stage from new to completed, who's leading it, and how long it's taken — call or message them right here.

description.title: Description
description.body: The full brief for the job — what needs doing. Click to edit it inline.

subtasks.title: Subtasks
subtasks.body: Break the job into smaller pieces, each with its own assignee and checklist.

checklist.title: Checklist
checklist.body: A simple to-do list for this job — tick items off as they're done and watch the progress bar fill.

attachments.title: Attachments
attachments.body: Photos and documents for the job — drag files in or upload, and open or delete them anytime.

dependencies.title: Dependencies
dependencies.body: Link this job to others — what blocks it and what it blocks — so the schedule stays in the right order.

customFields.title: Custom fields
customFields.body: Extra fields your team defined for this type of job — they save automatically as you type.

comments.title: Discuss it
comments.body: Leave notes and questions for whoever's on the job. Shift+Enter for a new line.

activity.title: Full history
activity.body: Every change is logged here — status changes, assignments, uploads — who did what, and when.

serviceReport.title: Service report
serviceReport.body: Once the job is completed, the field report lands here — work performed, duration, before/after photos, parts used and signatures.

routeTracking.title: Route & GPS
routeTracking.body: For jobs in the field, follow the technician's live route and travel details on the map.

sidebar.title: Details
sidebar.body: All the key facts on the right — assignees, due and start dates, location, estimated hours and who created it. Click any value to edit it.

agile.title: Agile
agile.body: Sprint, phase, epic and story points — set them here if your team runs agile.

profile.title: Member profile
profile.body: Their name, role, status, email and the spaces they belong to. Use Edit to change their profile, work schedule or reset their password.

tasks.title: Their work
tasks.body: What this member is working on — recent jobs, schedule and activity at a glance.

accessTab.title: Access
accessTab.body: This is where you control exactly what this member can see and do. Let's open it and go through it.

platform.title: Platform access
platform.body: Where they can sign in — web only (office), mobile only (field), or both.

permissions.title: Permissions
permissions.body: The core, enforced permissions: whether they can create jobs (and for whom), assign jobs to others, see all jobs, and manage people. These apply everywhere — UI and server.

features.title: Feature tabs
features.body: Which app tabs this member gets — Jobs, Clock (attendance) and Time Off.

attendance.title: Remote clock-in
attendance.body: Let them clock in from anywhere without standing at a site geofence (WFH / on the road). Needs the Clock tab enabled above.

spaces.title: Space visibility
spaces.body: How much they can see — only their assigned spaces, those plus spaces from their jobs, or every space in the org.

collaboration.title: Messaging
collaboration.body: Turn on so this member can chat with teammates — and be reached back. One switch for both directions.

contact.title: Contact access
contact.body: Scope exactly who they may reach: no one, everyone, or a specific list of people you pick.

management.title: Management directory
management.body: List this person so teammates can reach them from anywhere — and optionally let them build and run reports.

watchers.title: Notifications
watchers.body: Choose who gets alerted about this member — approvals, geofence events and more. Leave empty to fall back to default routing.

save.title: Save changes
save.body: Nothing changes until you Save — then their access updates everywhere instantly.

intro.title: Schedule
intro.body: See your whole team's availability at a glance — who's working, who's off, and when — by week or month.

summary.title: Today at a glance
summary.body: A quick snapshot for today: how many people are scheduled, how many are available, and how many are on time off.

view.title: Week or month
view.body: Switch between a week view (day-by-day detail) and a month view (the whole month at once).

space.title: Filter by space
space.body: Narrow the calendar to a single space, or show everyone across all of them.

dateNav.title: Move through time
dateNav.body: Jump to Today, or step back and forward a week or month with the arrows.

tabs.title: Calendar & time off
tabs.body: Switch between the availability calendar and the time-off requests to approve.

calendar.title: The calendar
calendar.body: Each day shows a bar for available, on time off and not scheduled. Click a day to see exactly who — grouped by space, with their hours.

dayDetail.title: Who's on that day
dayDetail.body: Opening a day lists everyone grouped by space — their shift hours, time-off reason and status. Click a name to open their profile.

legend.title: Colour key
legend.body: Green = available, amber = on time off, grey = not scheduled. The same colours are used everywhere on the calendar.

timeoffTab.title: Time-off requests
timeoffTab.body: This tab lists every time-off request — the badge shows how many are still waiting for you.

timeoff.title: Approve time off
timeoff.body: Review each request — who, when, how long and why — then approve or reject it right here. Filter by status to find what you need.

intro.title: Time off
intro.body: Ask for time off and track where each request stands — all from here.

form.title: New request
form.body: Fill this in to request vacation, sick leave or any day off. It goes to your manager for approval.

dates.title: Pick your dates
dates.body: Choose the first and last day you'll be away. For a single day, set both to the same date.

reason.title: Add a reason
reason.body: Optionally say why (vacation, doctor, family…) — it helps your manager decide faster.

submit.title: Send it
submit.body: Submit the request. Your manager gets notified and it appears below as Pending.

requests.title: Your requests
requests.body: Every request with its status — Pending, Approved, Rejected (with the reason) or Canceled. You can cancel a request while it's still pending.

intro.title: Settings
intro.body: Everything you can configure lives here — your organization on top (admins only), and your personal preferences below.

orgGroup.title: Organization
orgGroup.body: These settings apply to your whole company — its profile, how people join, task workflows, notifications and the audit log. Admins only.

general.title: Organization profile
general.body: Your company's name, industry, address and contact details — plus the logo that appears on report and statement PDFs. Saved instantly.

members.title: Join code & policy
members.body: Share (or regenerate) the code people use to join, and choose whether joining is open, invite-only or closed.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.body: Choose which org-wide emails and push alerts go out — on new tasks, completions and join requests.

workflows.title: Task types & workflows
workflows.body: Define the status flows and custom fields your jobs use — create task types, set their statuses, and add fields.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.body: A full trail of who did what and when — filter by event, person or date. Every change is traceable.

personalGroup.title: Personal
personalGroup.body: Just for you — these settings only affect your own account, not the organization.

profile.title: Your profile
profile.body: Your name, photo and email, and whether times show as 24-hour or 12-hour across the app.

security.title: Password
security.body: Change your password here — you'll need your current one, and the new one must be strong.

welcome.title: Set up your first space
welcome.subtitle: A space is where your tasks live — a site, a team, or a project. You can add more anytime.

roles.title: Roles
roles.subtitle: A role grants a set of permissions org-wide to every member who holds it.

scheduling.title: Space settings
scheduling.subtitle: Configure how this space handles attendance, shifts and members.

unauthorized.title: Access restricted
unauthorized.description: You need the manage-members permission to configure space scheduling.

notFound.title: Space not found
notFound.description: This space doesn't exist or you don't have access to it.

workModel.heading: Work model
workModel.intro: Choose how this space interprets attendance and time expectations.
workModel.remindersNote: Shift-based and fixed schedule models enable automatic clock-out reminders when someone stays past their expected end time.

NONE.label: No time expectations
NONE.description: No attendance schedule or reminders. Members clock in and out freely.

SHIFT.label: Shift-based
SHIFT.description: Members are assigned shift windows via the rota. Supports overnight shifts.

FIXED.label: Fixed weekly schedule
FIXED.description: A repeating weekly schedule defines expected working hours.

TASK.label: Task-based
TASK.description: Attendance follows task work, with no scheduled end time.

workModel.attendanceOnHint: Members clock in and out; scheduled members get clock-out reminders.
workModel.attendanceOffHint: Everyone clocks in and out freely, with no reminders.
workModel.onBulletScheduled: Members WITH a shift or rota (see the Shifts and Rota tabs) get scheduled clock-out reminders.
workModel.onBulletTaskBased: Members WITHOUT one are task-based — they clock in and out freely.
workModel.offBullet: Everyone clocks in and out freely, with no reminders.

shifts.heading: Shifts
shifts.intro: Define named shift windows for this space. Times are local to the space timezone.
shifts.dialogDescription: Set the shift window, break and reminder behaviour.
shifts.reminderHint: Grace is the wait after the shift end before the first reminder. Interval and max reminders control follow-ups before escalation.
shifts.deleteConfirm: Delete "{{name}}"? Existing rota assignments using it will be affected.

empty.title: No shifts yet
empty.description: Create a shift to start building the rota.

shifts.toleranceHint: Grace before an entry is flagged Late Arrival, Early Departure or Overtime.

rota.heading: Rota
rota.intro: Assign members to shifts on a recurring schedule.
rota.dialogDescription: Assign a member to a shift and set how it repeats.
rota.priorityHint: Higher priority wins when two assignments overlap on the same day.
rota.noShifts: No active shifts. Create one in the Shifts tab first.
rota.selectWeekdayError: Please select at least one weekday
rota.selectMonthDayError: Please select at least one day of the month
rota.selectDateError: Please add at least one date
rota.deleteConfirm: Remove this rota assignment? Past attendance history is preserved.

empty.title: No assignments yet
empty.description: Assign a member to a shift to build the rota.

grid.openHoursHint: These members work open hours — they clock in and out freely, with no reminders.
grid.conflictSummary: {{count}} scheduling conflict(s) this week — members double-booked on overlapping shifts.

roles.heading: Space roles
roles.intro: Define sub-roles like "Shift Leader" and the attendance permissions they grant.
roles.dialogDescription: Name the role and choose which space permissions it grants.
roles.deleteConfirm: Delete "{{name}}"? Members with this role will lose it.

empty.title: No custom roles yet
empty.description: Create a role to grant space-level permissions.

canApproveOvertime.label: Approve overtime
canApproveOvertime.description: Can approve extra-time requests for this space

canManageRota.label: Manage rota
canManageRota.description: Can create shifts and assign members to shifts

canReconcileAttendance.label: Reconcile attendance
canReconcileAttendance.description: Receives escalations and can close or fix open entries

canViewSpaceAttendance.label: View space attendance
canViewSpaceAttendance.description: Can see attendance for everyone in this space

members.heading: Space members
members.intro: Assign members to this space and optionally give them a sub-role.
members.empty: No members assigned to this space yet.
members.removeConfirm: {{name}} will lose their role and routing in this space. This does not remove them from the organization.

attendanceTab.heading: Attendance
attendanceTab.clockDesc: Everyone with the Clock module clocks in and out — on-site (geofence) or remotely. Set the geofence and remote clock-in in the General tab.
attendanceTab.openDesc: Clock in and out freely. No fixed shifts, no reminders.
attendanceTab.scheduledDesc: Assign people to shifts. Scheduled members get end-of-shift reminders; anyone left unassigned works open hours.
